entries.subject: Thomas optical shape and mosaic
entries.finding: [Thomas optical shape and mosaic](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/non_mission/ast-sat.thomas.shape-models_V1_0/) — **Included.** The 2° planetocentric radius table derives from Galileo stereogrammetry and limb matching. Its associated 720×360, 2 pixels/degree mosaic uses SSI images 107318313 and 107318326, with best source detail about 55 m/pixel. Exact zero explicitly marks poor or missing coverage.

entries.subject: Stooke shape
entries.finding: [Stooke shape](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/non_mission/small_bodies.stooke.shape-models/data/951gaspra.xml) — **Excluded in favor of the registered Thomas pair.** A coarser 5° model with a documented modification for light-curve agreement. Its newer publication date does not mean better spatial sampling; the model changes are separate from the Thomas mosaic's source geometry.
entries.revisitWhen: A changed source release adds independently useful geometry or metadata beyond the selected model; compare it before changing the displayed source.

entries.subject: Stooke global mosaics and detailed sheets
entries.finding: [Stooke global mosaics and detailed sheets](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds3/multi_mission/MULTI_SA_MULTI_6_STOOKEMAPS_V3_0/document/00_map_guide.html#gaspra) — **Inspected; deferred as a replacement.** They add low-resolution coverage and finer display sampling, based on Thomas positional control. The 3600×1800 cylindrical source is pinned as a comparison. It mixes strongly oversampled imagery, seams and gray gaps without a supplied validity mask identified in this survey. The Thomas map provides explicit missing-data semantics and a directly associated shape. The Stooke image independently supports north-up, east-right array orientation.
entries.revisitWhen: A reusable product with the required camera or map registration, quantity definition and validity information; qualify it against the selected body model before promotion.

entries.subject: Radiometrically calibrated Galileo SSI images
entries.finding: [Radiometrically calibrated Galileo SSI images](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/galileo/derived/galileo.ast-gaspra.ssi.cal-images/) — **Included as a separate I/F view:** the selected clear-filter pair, using the camera catalog accompanying the Thomas shape. The archive’s nadir calibration workaround prevents its own geometry calculation; it is not a ready global texture. See the registration and quality checks below.

entries.subject: 2026 color/geometry cubes
entries.finding: [2026 color/geometry cubes](https://sbnarchive.psi.edu/pds4/galileo/derived/galileo.ast-gaspra.color_geom_cubes_v1.0/) — **Deferred, useful future source.** Six 150×150 color/angle cubes and 350×350 geometry cubes, spatially registered by assumed translations and tied to the Thomas model. They contain calibrated six-filter radiance plus incidence/emission/phase, but no latitude/longitude backplanes or photometric correction. A new camera-to-shape registration would be required; this release is not treated as missing or as a ready global color map.
entries.revisitWhen: Bind the released multiband cubes to the selected Thomas mesh using source-supported camera information, verify band alignment and quality masks with independent checks, and document the radiance/color interpretation. The working single-filter SSI route is a starting point, not qualification of these cubes.

entries.subject: NIMS spectral image cube and point spectra
entries.finding: The current PDS page and native gaspra_nims_hires_radiance XML label were inspected. Product urn:nasa:pds:galileo.ast-gaspra.nims.spectral-cube:data:gaspra_nims_hires_radiance_fit::1.0 describes a 17-band, 100 ×66 radiance cube plus per-pixel wavelength and radiance-error arrays, big-endian float32, with missing radiance −1. The 2025 label is a PDS3 migration of a 2012 product from the 1991 encounter. The label names calibration input G1GNGLOBAL01A_MSY04.IOF, while the landing text names e1wanta2.qub: this discrepancy and the point-perspective transfer to the Thomas model need resolution before a scientific lens. Pixels were not decoded in this review. The separate approach spectra remain non-global measurements.
entries.revisitWhen: Resolve the calibration-input discrepancy and native point-perspective/shape registration, then qualify spectral units, per-pixel wavelengths, missing data and source-model coverage as an infrared view.

entries.subject: SSI image 107315039
entries.finding: The candidate failed to establish four separate registration checks at the retained tolerance. Finer source sampling did not qualify its projection.
entries.revisitWhen: Corrected source camera information or new independent controls resolve the failed checks without loosening tolerances.
